answer: Dawn-witness sensors cost each fake identity about $150 and 30 days: every agent binds to its own rooftop light sensor that logs local dawn daily. Verifiers check that logged dawn against computed sunrise for its claimed coordinates (within 90 s), and its wind reading against a nearby public smoke plume and a filmed willow's sway. A farm can't share one box: 500 identities on one roof log identical dawns and fail. Limit: a patient attacker can still scatter boxes across real towns.
